validation: Wine reader e389-white-flowers-residual-switches-readers-wine-rf3njife verifies 46 original interpreter/generated dispatch cases, 14 guard and 14 out-of-projection fallback cases, all destinations through altered mirrors and mixed boundaries, and previous resources.

limitations: The 031618 out-of-range helper may return; the original fallback is preserved, but behavior after that helper remains outside this controlled test.
The address-only sample does not establish executing PCs or selector ancestry. Other readers, scenes, source-save history, real BIOS, UI save/Load and full-ROM coverage remain open.
Older revision-sensitive Wine fixtures need adaptation and rerun; Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance comparison was made.
